iac.name: iac

asset.name: asset
asset.title: Asset this root belongs to
asset.desc: Platform, version, identity and labels of the asset this root describes.

detection.name: detection
detection.title: Infrastructure-as-code entry point
detection.desc: One place in the tree that a tool accepted as its own, and the asset that was made of it. The `tool` field is the name `--discover` takes, so `iac.detections.where(tool == "terraform")` lists what one tool claimed, and `iac.detections { tool path asset }` lists what a scan of this tree produces with the same identity the scan reports. A tool that simply did not want a candidate leaves nothing behind. See ADR 030 and ADR 031.

detections.name: detections
detections.title: Entry points found in the tree

source.name: source
source.title: Where the tree was read from

iac.title: Infrastructure as code project
iac.desc: Tree of infrastructure-as-code files reached by this connection, and the entry points found in it. Each detection names the tool that claimed the entry point, the directory or file it was found at, the files that matched, and the asset the tool made of it. Use it to see what a scan of a repository produces before drilling into any one tool.

iac.detection.name: iac.detection

asset.name: asset
asset.title: Asset the tool made of this entry point
asset.desc: Null when the tool reported an error instead of connecting.

error.name: error
error.title: Error the tool reported for this entry point, empty when it connected

path.name: path
path.title: Path of the entry point, relative to the root of the tree

tool.name: tool
tool.title: Tool the entry point belongs to, such as terraform or helm

iac.source.name: iac.source

kind.name: kind
kind.title: Kind of source, one of file, git, archive, container-image, ssh, or oci

origin.name: origin
origin.title: Coordinate of the source, such as an absolute path or a repository URL

ref.name: ref
ref.title: Revision of the source, such as a git ref or an image tag

iac.source.title: Source of an infrastructure-as-code tree
iac.source.desc: Coordinate the tree was read from, and the revision it was read at. A tree on this machine reports a kind of `file` and an absolute path as its origin.
